name: 橙子教室 Word 大纲层级表
scope: ChengziClass editable Word masters. PDF export/review is out of scope for this file.
principle: Every semantic content role has an explicit outline classification. Heading-like roles use Word outline levels 0-8, corresponding to visible levels 1-9. Non-heading content uses outlineLevel=body, which is written as Word/OOXML outlineLvl=9, and must not enter the table of contents.

tocPolicy.sourceOfEntries: Word paragraph outline levels from registered CZ styles; TOC entries must not be typed as static text.
tocPolicy.nestedPageReferenceFields: Word may generate nested PAGEREF fields inside each visible TOC result; audits must treat those as part of the same parent TOC field result, not as static text.

documentTitle.description: Optional whole-document title when a Word master has a true document-level title.

chapterTitle.description: Unit, lecture, topic, chapter, or lesson-start title.

heading1.description: Major teaching module under a chapter.

heading2.description: Body subheading below a lesson or session title. It remains outside the default student TOC, whose field includes only visible levels 1-2.

heading3.description: Optional third-level teaching heading. Student handouts do not show it in the TOC unless explicitly approved.

heading4.description: Column banner inside a teaching period — 探新知 / 揭规律 / 帮解题 / 刷好题.

heading5.description: Knowledge point or exam point inside a column.

exerciseGroupTitle.description: Exercise-group label. It is visually heading-like but is body outline content and must never enter the student TOC.

passageLabel.description: Reading passage labels such as A/B or Passage A/B.

body.description: Normal body text and short body paragraphs.

longText.description: Reading passages, Chinese long text, English articles, and other long body material.

exerciseStem.description: Questions, stems, examples, and numbered exercise items.

exerciseContinuation.description: Continuation paragraphs under a question or numbered item.

answerLine.description: Answer blanks, writing lines, and answer areas.

tocTitle.description: The visible TOC title. It is not a TOC entry.

sourceNote.description: Production/source note. Student handouts must not display it.

textbookHierarchy.rule: 教材目录六层:主题 > 专题 > 课题 > 课时 > 栏目 > 知识点。各层一一对应下列样式;同一层重复出现的标题只出一次。
textbookHierarchy.sourceOfTruth: 源文件目录树:主题目录 / 专题目录 / 课题目录 / 每课时一个文件。文档内部的专题、课题标题与目录同名,只在该层第一次出现时排版,其余作为重复标题排除。
